```
frank: Quick follow-up on FA v3 integration — seeing a throughput drop on mixed short+long sequences after the RFC rollout. small-batch latency up, GPU util lower. anyone else running into this?

emily: saw some noise in nightly perf too. can you drop numbers and a minimal repro?

frank: repro attached (short summary):
```
Model: redwood-v1
Batch mix: 60% seq=8, 40% seq=256
Batch sizes: 1,4,8
FA v2 (baseline): 1200 tok/s
FA v3 (post-rfc): 920 tok/s
Kernel fallbacks: v2 3.2% -> v3 12.1%
Observed: increased kernel launches, higher temp workspace churn
```

josh: could be workspace fragmentation. FA v3 kernels use a bit more per-call temp memory and we round to slab sizes in the workspace pool. if many short seqs interleave with long ones pool fragmentation + extra device syncs can kill throughput.

emily: telemetry confirms lots of small allocations and repeated kernel launches for the same logical op. enabling per-device workspace pooling debug shows free-list churn.

frank: enabling the pool-level coalescing flag (-Xworkspace-coalesce) reduced the regression from 23% to ~8% in my run.

tara: another angle: kernel selector fallback threshold. right now we pick v3 whenever seq_len >= 16 (naive). v3 shines on medium/long but regresses on tiny seqs because of launch overhead + extra workspace setup. suggest changing selector to prefer v2 for (seq_len <= 32 && batch_size <= 4) or if percent_short > 50% in a route.

josh: i sketched a heuristic prototype:
```
if (pct_short > 0.5 && median_seq <= 32 && batch_size <= 4) use_fa2();
else if (median_seq >= 128) use_fa3();
else use_perf_model_decision();
```
we should run this through the offline perf model with our seq-dist dataset.

emily: also noticed v3 increases kernel fallback rate when quantized attention path is hit (int8 kernels not fully supported in one codepath) — need clearer telemetry tags for "quant-fallback" vs "workspace-fallback". current logs lump them together.

frank: good call. i'll add TL-tagged counters: attention_kernel_variant, fallback_reason. will re-run.

build-bot: canary deploy of runtime-2026.03.18-fa3-heuristic-patch completed on region-us-west-2 :white_check_mark:

tara: can we A/B route 5% of traffic to the canary with the new selector? want real-world mix.

matt: done. added rollout policy: 5% shard, degrade-to-fa2 on 10% latency increase or 2x error rate. monitor dashboards for kernel_fallback_rate and avg_token_latency.

frank: early canary numbers: kernel_fallback_rate -> down from 12% to 4%, p50 token latency back to baseline, p95 improved slightly. GPU util stable. promising.

emily: let's keep telemetry for 48h then iterate on selector thresholds. also file an RFC follow-up note with the experiment matrix (seq dist, batch sizes, quant flag) so this is reproducible.

josh: i'll own the follow-up doc + perf plots. frank can you attach the raw trace and the pool debug dump when you have it?

frank: yup sending traces shortly. thanks all :thumbsup:
```
